lesson_title: A New Heart in Cape Town
hook_text: Cape Town, December 1967. For the first time in history, a human heart is moved from one person into another. Will it beat?
clip_script: Groote Schuur Hospital, the night of the second of December 1967. A young woman, Denise Darvall, has died after a car accident, and her father agrees to donate her heart. In the next theatre, Louis Washkansky is dying of heart failure. Christiaan Barnard and a team of about thirty work through the night. The new heart is shocked, and it starts to beat. The world's first human heart transplant has happened, in South Africa.
visual_style: Whiteboard Cape Town skyline with Groote Schuur Hospital, two operating tables side by side, a heart moving from one to the other, then newspaper headlines from around the world.
mood: Dramatic and moving, a story of courage, grief and hope.
pacing: A tense night-time operation told step by step, then reflection on what followed.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write a newspaper headline and short report about the first heart transplant.
